label: WRONG
reason: Real services (ChatService, DocumentService, AbstractPaperlessService) carry @Injectable({providedIn:'root'}), but the only outlier FileStatus is a plain data/progress model co-located in websocket-status.service.ts next to the injectable WebsocketStatusService; another such model class in a service file would be flagged for nothing (0 of 1 counted). Angular would catch a real DI-ed service without the decorator, but not this kind of violation.

label: ACCEPT
reason: All other inputs (check, select, number, date, permissions-form) extend AbstractInputComponent<T>; TagsComponent instead re-implements ControlValueAccessor by hand, duplicating writeValue/registerOnChange/setDisabledState/title/disabled/hint from abstract-input.ts, even though SelectComponent shows an ng-select input can extend the base. No lint or type rule enforces the base class, so flagging a new input that skips it is worth a review look.

label: WRONG
reason: @Component classes (AppComponent, DocumentListComponent, SettingsComponent) end in Component, but all five outliers are other kinds of class in *.component files: three plain selection/query model classes co-located with their dropdowns, and two base classes (abstract @Directive LoadingComponentWithPermissions, plain ComponentWithPermissions); 0 of 5 counted are mistakes. eslint.config.js does not enable @angular-eslint/component-class-suffix, so not TRIVIAL either.
